FOUNDER'S MESSAGE

A Word From Our Founder


Chanderhass Sorout

Founder · Primeora Global

Young entrepreneur from Haryana

Building Strength,
Creating Tomorrow

“

Primeora Global was started with a simple belief: land is more than an asset — it is the foundation on which communities, businesses and futures are built.

Coming from Haryana, I have seen how the right partnership can change what a piece of land becomes. Our aim is to work with landowners and developers openly and fairly, whether through outright purchase, long-term lease, joint venture or joint development.

We are a young company with big ambitions — to grow across India with transparency, trust and a long-term view. If you have land or a vision to build, I invite you to connect with us. Let’s build tomorrow, together.

Chanderhass SoroutFounder, Primeora Global

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions


What land do you look for?

Agricultural and industrial parcels — 15 acres+ in Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Pune and Kolkata, and 2 acres+ in Mumbai.

Do you buy or lease land?

Both. We acquire through outright purchase as well as long-term lease arrangements.

What details should I share?

Location, total land area, land type (agricultural / industrial), ownership details, expected price or lease terms, and contact person details.

Do you do joint ventures or joint development?

Yes — JV and JD structures are part of our core capabilities.

How do I reach you?

Use the enquiry form below or write to primeora.global@gmail.com.
